## Summary

Describe the change in one or two sentences. Name the behavior, route, screen,
or document that reviewers should see now.

## Why

Explain the problem, bug, or documentation gap that made this change necessary.

## Validation

List the exact commands you ran and their results. If you skipped a relevant
check, say why.

## Operator Notes

Mention migrations, env vars, restarts, registry changes, or manual steps. Write
`None` if there are no operator actions.

## Security and Privacy

Confirm that the PR does not add secrets, private paths, live database files,
or unredacted personal data. Call out any new public route or auth behavior.
